The key is `JSON.stringify([ctx?.recordId, authored action names])`, computed in `renderHeaderActions`, which runs on every render (not inside a memo), so a stale cap is never read. A cap is used only when its key equals the current one; otherwise the row draws `maxVisible` and the unchanged layout effect re-measures and writes a cap under the new key.
